format: As strokes.json: chars per character, one flat [x0,y0,x1,y1,...] array per stroke median; cases with ink flat the same way; coordinates are integers = unit-box value x scale (0..1 across the pad, y down); expect.kind match|miss, expect.strokes when present must equal the result. links: per character, one entry per consecutive stroke pair (k to k+1), what joinLink answers: "near" (gap rule), "flow" (flow rule) or null. Source: see "source"; one case per line.
